topics.name: UserModule Type Compatibility Validation
topics.purpose: Define validation that a UserModule's declared primary type matches its exposed interfaces, lifecycle, writes/effects and namespace behavior, preventing type labels from becoming cosmetic metadata.

semantics.command_rule: Command type may execute only through explicit command/operation dispatch.
semantics.input_rule: Input type may ingest/write declared data but cannot directly execute arbitrary effects.
semantics.adapter_rule: Adapter type may translate/mount but cannot own hidden command/effect semantics.
semantics.view_rule: View type may project/read and invoke separate explicit operations but cannot own backend mutation semantics.
semantics.composition_rule: Composite/MetaModule behavior must declare the composition instead of mislabeling a broad module as one narrow type.

invariants.rule: UserModule type behavior is explicit and narrow: input acquires/writes inert data, adapter translates/mounts, view projects, and no type silently acquires another type's authority.

hard_gates.condition: declared type disagrees with actual canonical interfaces/effects
broad composite misdeclared as narrow single type
